title: Portable ECG
dek: FDA-cleared pocket ECG devices capture a medical-grade rhythm strip in 30 seconds — ready to share with your doctor.

title: Home Blood Pressure
dek: Cuffless rings and watches are racing ahead, but a good upper-arm blood pressure monitor remains the reading doctors actually trust.

title: Pulse Oximeter
dek: From pandemic essential to forgotten drawer item — and now back as a smarter, more accurate home sensor.

title: OTC Glucose
dek: Prescription barriers dropped. Now anyone curious about food, sleep, and stress can see how their glucose actually moves.

title: Fitbit Edge Launch
dek: Google launched the Fitbit Edge on October 12. It sits between the screenless Fitbit Air and the full Pixel Watch — exactly the middle ground many people have been asking for.

title: Fitbit Edge Tease
dek: Google just confirmed the Fitbit Edge is coming on October 12. The bigger story is what people actually want from a tracker right now: multi-day battery over another app-heavy smartwatch.

title: Amazfit Bip Max
dek: At about $100, the Bip Max adds a brighter 2.07-inch AMOLED, offline maps, and multi-week battery to the budget watch formula.

title: Amazfit Bip 6
dek: For about the price of a casual dinner out, the Bip 6 brings a bright AMOLED screen, onboard GPS, and health tracking that used to cost much more.

title: Amazfit GTS 4 Mini
dek: Delivers a genuine smartwatch experience with a vivid HD AMOLED display, standalone 5-satellite GPS, and 15-day battery life.

title: Galaxy Fit 3
dek: Lightweight aluminum frame featuring a 1.6-inch AMOLED touchscreen, fall detection, sleep coaching, and 13 days of charge.

title: CMF Watch Pro
dek: A bold, geometric smartwatch offering a massive 1.96-inch AMOLED display and built-in multi-system GPS for just $69.

title: Fitbit Charge 6
dek: Google’s fitness band with ECG, built-in GPS, and YouTube Music controls — still one of the most complete trackers under $160.

title: Amazfit Active 2
dek: Bright AMOLED, multi-day battery, and solid health tracking without the premium price tag.

title: Active 2, Long Battery
dek: A closer look at why multi-week battery life still beats another app-heavy smartwatch for most people.

title: Galaxy A16 5G
dek: Samsung’s budget 5G phone with a smooth display and long software support window.

title: Galaxy A15 5G
dek: A capable everyday 5G phone that keeps costs low without feeling stripped down.

title: Galaxy A16 4G
dek: The 4G version of Samsung’s budget A-series for buyers who don’t need 5G yet.

title: Moto G 2026
dek: Solid battery and clean Android under $150 — a dependable daily driver without the clutter.

title: Moto G Play
dek: The unbeatable battery champion under $120 for buyers who just want a phone that lasts.

title: Nothing Ear (a)
dek: Vibrant audio and effective ANC under $100 with that signature translucent design.
